long_biography.plain_text:
Arriving in the United States from Cuba as a child, Miguel ‘Mike’ B. Fernandez worked while attending school and later served in the army. He entered insurance through door-to-door sales, identified an underserved market in health insurance and turned that opening into a career building managed-care enterprises. His early ventures included a benefits database business and Physicians Healthcare Plans, which he led before selling it.

Fernandez repeated that build-and-divest model across health plans, medical centres, pharmacy services and hospitalist care. He subsequently founded MBF Healthcare Partners, where he remains chairman and backs healthcare service companies nationwide. He has also directed philanthropy towards medical research, education and immigration support through his family foundation and advocacy organisations.

His early ventures included a benefits database business and Physicians Healthcare Plans, which he led before selling it.

Fernandez repeated that build-and-divest model across health plans, medical centres, pharmacy services and hospitalist care. He subsequently founded MBF Healthcare Partners, where he remains chairman and backs healthcare service companies nationwide. He has also directed philanthropy towards medical research, education and immigration support through his family foundation and advocacy organisations.
